sloka: वाच्यः तातः यवीयान् मे सुग्रीवो वानर ईश्वरः ।आरोग्य पूर्वम् कुशलम् वाच्या माता रुमा च मे ॥४-५५-१४॥
transliteration: vācyaḥ tātaḥ yavīyān me sugrīvo vānara īśvaraḥ ।ārogya pūrvam kuśalam vācyā mātā rumā ca me ॥4-55-14॥

translations.english: 'You should convey my mother as well as Ruma my good wishes for their health and wellbeing. You should console my mother Tara also.
